messages.subject: Entry level job opening for R programmer in Austin, TX
parts:
Hi everyone,
I am looking to hire a solid R programmer who is skilled in the packages developed by Hadley, particularly ggplot2, plyr, and testthat. My company, Qcue (www.qcue.com), is a start-up based in Austin, TX that works as pricing consultants to professional sports teams. We are a small, fun team looking for someone to primarily support me in the analytics work I do. A document with more details on the job is attached.

If you are interested in this position, please submit an application. If this position is not for you, please distribute widely to anyone you know that might be interested. Finally, if you have any suggestions on where to post this opening to find good folks, please let me know.

Best wishes,
Doug

p.s. I know it isn't the norm on this mailing list to be posting job openings, so I checked with Hadley before sending this out and he said it is ok. I don't mean to offend anyone by using this space to look for good R programmers!
